newsitem.title: FINLAND: STAMP DUTY ON LOANS OUTDATED - NIINISTO.
newsitem.headline: STAMP DUTY ON LOANS OUTDATED - NIINISTO.

text.p: Finland's stamp duty on loans is outdated and the government must look for ways to modernise it, Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto told a tax seminar on Tuesday.
"The entire stamp duty on credits as such belongs in the tax museum. But how would the gap in the region of 700 million markka that the stamp duty brings in be collected?" he said.

Niinisto repeated that the trend in income taxes is still downward and said there are no unsurmountable obstacles to meeting the necessary conditions for lower income taxes -- a strong economic development and moderation in state finances.
"I believe the direction in income taxes is clearly what it should be: lower," Niinisto said.
He said on Monday there would be scope for further income tax cuts if the budget balance improved as currently projected and it the next wage deal is moderate.
